import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class BasicJava
{
   public static void main(String[] args)
   {
      Task Main = new Task();
      
      Main.solve();
   }
   
   public static class Task
   {
      public InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
      public PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
      
      public void solve()
      {
         int w = in.nextInt();
         int m = in.nextInt();
         
         int[] t = new int[110];
         
         int nr = 0;
         
         while (m > 0) {
            
            nr++; t[nr] = m % w;
            
            m = m / w;
            
         }
         
         for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++)
            if (t[i] > w / 2) {
               
               t[i] = - (t[i] - w);
               
               t[i + 1] ++;
               
               
            }
         
         if (t[nr] == 1) nr++;
         
         for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++)
            if (t[i] > 1) {
               
               System.out.println("NO");
               
               System.exit(0);
               
            }
         
         System.out.println("YES");
         
      }
   }
   
   static class InputReader
   {
      private InputStream stream;
      private byte[] buf = new byte[2048];
      private int curChar;
      private int numChars;
 
      public InputReader(InputStream stream)
      {
         this.stream = stream;
      }
 
      public int read()
      {
         if (numChars == -1)
            throw new UnknownError();
         if (curChar >= numChars)
         {
            curChar = 0;
            try
            {
               numChars = stream.read(buf);
            }
            catch (IOException e)
            {
               throw new UnknownError();
            }
            if (numChars <= 0)
               return -1;
         }
         return buf[curChar++];
      }
 
      public int peek()
      {
         if (numChars == -1)
            return -1;
         if (curChar >= numChars)
         {
            curChar = 0;
            try
            {
               numChars = stream.read(buf);
            }
            catch (IOException e)
            {
               return -1;
            }
            if (numChars <= 0)
               return -1;
         }
         return buf[curChar];
      }
 
      public void skip(int x)
      {
         while (x-- > 0)
            read();
      }
 
      public int nextInt()
      {
         return Integer.parseInt(next());
      }
 
      public long nextLong()
      {
         return Long.parseLong(next());
      }
 
      public String nextString()
      {
         return next();
      }
 
      public String next()
      {
         int c = read();
         while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
         StringBuffer res = new StringBuffer();
         do
         {
            res.appendCodePoint(c);
            c = read();
         }
         while (!isSpaceChar(c));
 
         return res.toString();
      }
 
      public String nextLine()
      {
         StringBuffer buf = new StringBuffer();
         int c = read();
         while (c != '\n' && c != -1)
         {
            if (c != '\r')
               buf.appendCodePoint(c);
            c = read();
         }
         return buf.toString();
      }
 
      public double nextDouble()
      {
         int c = read();
         while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
         int sgn = 1;
         if (c == '-')
         {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
         }
         double res = 0;
         while (!isSpaceChar(c) && c != '.')
         {
            if (c == 'e' || c == 'E')
               return res * Math.pow(10, nextInt());
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
               throw new InputMismatchException();
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
         }
         if (c == '.')
         {
            c = read();
            double m = 1;
            while (!isSpaceChar(c))
            {
               if (c == 'e' || c == 'E')
                  return res * Math.pow(10, nextInt());
               if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                  throw new InputMismatchException();
               m /= 10;
               res += (c - '0') * m;
               c = read();
            }
         }
         return res * sgn;
      }
 
      public boolean hasNext()
      {
         int value;
         while (isSpaceChar(value = peek()) && value != -1)
            read();
         return value != -1;
      }
 
      private boolean isSpaceChar(int c)
      {
         return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
      }
 
   }
   
}

import sys

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.stream = stream
        self.buf = bytearray(2048)
        self.curChar = 0
        self.numChars = 0

    def read(self):
        if self.numChars == -1:
            raise Exception("Unknown Error")
        if self.curChar >= self.numChars:
            self.curChar = 0
            try:
                self.numChars = self.stream.readinto(self.buf)
            except Exception as e:
                raise Exception("Unknown Error")
            if self.numChars <= 0:
                return -1
        return self.buf[self.curChar]

    def peek(self):
        if self.numChars == -1:
            return -1
        if self.curChar >= self.numChars:
            self.curChar = 0
            try:
                self.numChars = self.stream.readinto(self.buf)
            except Exception as e:
                return -1
            if self.numChars <= 0:
                return -1
        return self.buf[self.curChar]

    def skip(self, x):
        while x > 0:
            self.read()
            x -= 1

    def nextInt(self):
        return int(self.next())

    def nextLong(self):
        return int(self.next())

    def nextString(self):
        return self.next()

    def next(self):
        c = self.read()
        while c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 or c == 9 or c == -1:
            c = self.read()
        res = ""
        while not (c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 or c == 9 or c == -1):
            res += chr(c)
            c = self.read()
        return res

    def nextLine(self):
        res = ""
        c = self.read()
        while c != 10 and c != -1:
            if c != 13:
                res += chr(c)
            c = self.read()
        return res

    def nextDouble(self):
        c = self.read()
        while c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 or c == 9:
            c = self.read()
        sgn = 1
        if c == 45:
            sgn = -1
            c = self.read()
        res = 0
        while not (c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 or c == 9 or c == 46):
            if c == 69 or c == 69:
                return res * (10 ** self.nextInt())
            if c < 48 or c > 57:
                raise Exception("InputMismatchException")
            res *= 10
            res += c - 48
            c = self.read()
        if c == 46:
            c = self.read()
            m = 1
            while not (c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 or c == 9):
                if c == 69 or c == 69:
                    return res * (10 ** self.nextInt())
                if c < 48 or c > 57:
                    raise Exception("InputMismatchException")
                m /= 10
                res += (c - 48) * m
                c = self.read()
        return res * sgn

    def hasNext(self):
        value = self.peek()
        while value == 32 and value != -1:
            self.read()
            value = self.peek()
        return value != -1

class Task:
    def __init__(self):
        self.in = InputReader(sys.stdin.buffer)
        self.out = sys.stdout

    def solve(self):
        w = self.in.nextInt()
        m = self.in.nextInt()
        t = [0] * 110
        nr = 0
        while m > 0:
            nr += 1
            t[nr] = m % w
            m = m // w
        for i in range(1, nr + 1):
            if t[i] > w // 2:
                t[i] = -(t[i] - w)
                t[i + 1] += 1
        if t[nr] == 1:
            nr += 1
        for i in range(1, nr + 1):
            if t[i] > 1:
                print("NO")
                sys.exit(0)
        print("YES")

def main():
    task = Task()
    task.solve()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
